Sam (AE): FYI handing Aurum Health to CS. Private deploy (VPC + Dedicated GPUs). Go-live target ~3w. Key risks: SAML SSO cert rotation still outstanding, infra quota for burst not approved, trial usage low -> renewal risk. I'll drop context below and assign owners. :wave:

Priya (CSM): Thanks Sam. Can you paste the SSO contact and the provisioning checklist? I'll own kickoff and enablement session. :+1:

Sam (AE): SSO contact: Mira Patel, mira@aurum.health. IdP: OneLogin (SAML). Provisioning ticket: #5678. Private deploy config: `env=prod, region=us-west-2, reserved_gpus=2, burst=4`.

Lina (SRE-Solutions): Adding myself for infra onboarding. Sam, what steady-state QPS / token rate should we size for? Any model prefs? Also need the VPC peering CIDR.

Sam (AE): Expected peak 40 qps, avg 12 qps. Model: redwood-llm-large-quantized (cpu fallback planned). VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16. Expect KV-cache warmup costs early.

Ethan (Support): Looping in support. Need log access (stack id) and monitoring alert thresholds. What's the SLA requirement from the customer? Any compliance attachments (DPA/BAA)?

Sam (AE): SLA requested: 99.9% latency SLO for <200ms p50 on chat endpoints. They signed our standard DPA; HIPAA pend (legal working it). Stack id for logs: aurum-prod-87. I've uploaded contract excerpt to the drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/aurum/contract_excerpt.pdf

deploy-bot: Provisioning ticket #5678 created (assignee: infra-provision). ETA for initial infra: 5 business days.

Priya (CSM): Plan of record: I will run a 60-min enablement session week of Apr 14. Lina to confirm infra readiness by Apr 10 so we can do canary. Ethan please prepare support runbook; include escalation to oncall-eng and SRE lead. I'll create CS playbook and track renewal risk.

Lina (SRE-Solutions): Acknowledged. I'll validate quotas and follow up on burst approval. If quota delayed, we'll propose a canary on reduced capacity + auto-fallback to hosted model variant. ETA: infra readiness check by Apr 8.

Ethan (Support): Will draft runbook. What about ops contacts at customer for after-hours? Sam?

Sam (AE): After-hours contact: support on-call via +1-555-412-9000 (Mira copied). Also point of escalation: CTO - Rajesh Kapoor, rajesh@aurum.health

Priya (CSM): Owners & next actions: 
- Priya: kickoff + enablement scheduling, customer comms, renewal flagging
- Lina: infra readiness, VPC peering, canary plan
- Ethan: support runbook, log access, monitoring alerts
- Sam: supply SAML cert details, legal updates
I'll put these in a shared ticket and set weekly sync Mondays 10am PT. Invite sent.

Sam (AE): Added sample SAML cert rotation snippet:
```
- cert_valid_until: 2025-06-01
- rotate_window_days: 30
```
We'll confirm cert export from OneLogin before infra cutover.

Priya (CSM): Noted. I'll also capture feedback checklist: first-30d adoption prompts, sample prompts they want to test, and a token-usage watchlist. Can someone from solutions provide sample throughput tests?

Lina (SRE-Solutions): I'll drop a simple load test plan in the ticket: 1) 5m warmup @5qps 2) step to 40 qps over 10m 3) validate p50/p95 latency and error rate. Will include command snippets.

Ethan (Support): Created support ticket #S-8922 for runbook & alerts. Priya, please attach enablement recording there after session.

Priya (CSM): Thanks all. Quick ask: mark renewal risk as "watch" (low-medium) for now; escalate if we see <30% adoption by day 21. :warning:

Sam (AE): Agree. I'll notify Sales leadership and keep outreach cadence. :thumbsup:

Priya (CSM): Cool — will follow up after infra check. Closing initial handoff notes here. /cc @Lina @Ethan @deploy-bot
